description_en: Checks the Cloud Data Transfer (CDT) service required to add a specified region to an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 检查指定的地域加入专线网关所需的云数据传输服务
name: CheckAddRegionToExpressConnectRouter

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR)
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en: The region for which you want to check whether the Cloud Data Transfer (CDT) service is enabled for the Express Connect Router (ECR) feature
parameters.help_zh: 指定专线网关功能是否开通云数据传输服务的地域
parameters.name: fresh_region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run on this request. Valid values:

true: sends a check request and does not modify EPS resources.

false: sends a normal request. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the parameter value on your client and ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken parameter only supports ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial

AnyCrossBorderLink.description_en:
Indicates whether the Express Connect Router (ECR) instance has cross-border connections between the Chinese mainland and regions outside the Chinese mainland. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No
AnyCrossBorderLink.description_zh:
专线网关实例是否存在中国内地与中国境外跨境。取值：
true：是。
false：否

AnyInterRegionLink.description_en:
Indicates whether the Express Connect Router (ECR) instance has cross-region connections in the Chinese mainland. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No
AnyInterRegionLink.description_zh:
专线网关实例是否存在中国内地跨地域。取值：
true：是。
false：否

Code.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A return value of 200 indicates that the request was successful. Any other value indicates that the request failed. For more information about the causes of failure, see Error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace `%s` in the ErrMessage error message.

If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsInstanceId, it indicates that the DtsInstanceId request parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsInstanceId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsInstanceId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

IsCdtCrossBorderEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the cross-border Cloud Data Transfer (CDT) service is enabled for the account to which the Express Connect Router (ECR) instance belongs. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No
IsCdtCrossBorderEnabled.description_zh:
专线网关实例所属账号是否开通跨境云数据传输（CDT）服务。取值：
true：是。
false：否

IsUserAllowedToCreateCrossBorderLink.description_en:

false: No
IsUserAllowedToCreateCrossBorderLink.description_zh:

true：是。
false：否
